text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: O... Oooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Un... believable, Mejiro Ramonu...!
To run like this in her debut race...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, look. Just now...
Mejiro Ramonu...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...From now on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It's okay to love you...
even more, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I can let it all out now, can't I?
Everything I've kept dammed up inside..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
“How...
wonderful...――”

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text:
Lady... Mejiro Ramonu...
How radiant...
Hard to believe she just finished a grueling race, with a smile that looks as if she's in love—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And so, I shall ask
what I wish to know most~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is true.
It is something found within your heart, Trainer~.
—I wanted to know more about Mejiro Ramonu. Because I felt that I didn't truly understand her.

And yet, I already knew the one thing I most wanted to know...
No, the one thing I needed to know as a Trainer.

"Simply because I love racing." 
If that's the case, then charge ahead without hesitation. Toward that shining goal—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Target Race.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's make up our minds.

text_block_list.text:
The main goal for the Classic year is the Tiara route...
To win the Oka Sho, the Japanese Oaks, and the Shuka Sho, achieving the Triple Tiara.
choice_data_list: Before that, there's a race I want you to run!

text_block_list.text: I want to make a statement for the future in a big Junior Class race... a GⅠ. One where many Umamusume aspiring for the Tiara route compete—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmm...
choice_data_list: Let's blaze a trail through the Classic Year from here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
Passionate, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
That sounds delightful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A GⅠ—
What an enchanting ring to it.
Speaking of GⅠs, they are high-class races that only Umamusume with proven ability can enter. Truly the centerpiece of racing, aimed for by all and watched by all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I do not mind.

Though I got a little ahead of myself,
our next goal before taking on the Triple Tiara has been set: the Hanshin JF!
